representation_contract.name: BRIDGE_SEPARATOR_COMPONENT_FACTORED_BOOLEAN_INTERFACE
representation_contract.primal_graph: one vertex per frame variable; undirected edge between every pair of variables co-occurring in one frozen CNF clause
representation_contract.component_rule: remove all bridge vertices B from the primal graph; take deterministic connected components of the remaining internal-variable graph; sort variables within each component ascending and sort components lexicographically by their variable tuples
representation_contract.clause_partition_rule: a clause containing internal variables belongs to the unique internal component containing all of its internal variables; a clause containing only bridge variables belongs to BRIDGE_ONLY. If one clause contains internal variables from multiple computed components, FAIL_INTEGRITY because the primal decomposition is inconsistent.
representation_contract.factor_semantics: for component C_i, F_i(C_i,B_i) is the conjunction of all clauses assigned to C_i; the local factor is G_i(B_i)=exists_C_i F_i(C_i,B_i); bridge-only clauses form G_0(B). The terminal representation is the factor set {G_0,G_1,...,G_k}, evaluated by conjunction without materializing a global Boolean DAG.
representation_contract.exact_identity: exists_Y F(Y,B) = G_0(B) AND product_i G_i(B_i), because internal component variable sets are pairwise disjoint and clauses couple distinct components only through bridge variables
representation_contract.local_compiler: sealed R18 HASHCONS_AND_OR_DAG_WITH_SHANNON_EXISTENTIAL_QUANTIFICATION operations applied independently to each component factor; no new Boolean simplification rule
representation_contract.local_elimination_order: sealed r18.elimination_order on each local component CNF with its local bridge support; all component internal variables must be eliminated
representation_contract.terminal_support: every local factor root may reference only frozen bridge variables; no original internal variable may remain

resource_envelope.note: The envelope is global across the whole factorized candidate; components do not each receive a fresh 120-second or 1M-node budget.

post_terminal_verifier.domain: all 2^11 assignments of the frozen W05 bridge
post_terminal_verifier.candidate_factor_evaluation: evaluate each retained local factor DAG directly and AND the Boolean results; no global factor materialization
post_terminal_verifier.match: FP=0 AND FN=0 AND allowed-set hashes equal
post_terminal_verifier.mismatch: freeze semantic counterexample; do not retune decomposition in R23

success_gate: all original internal variables assigned to exactly one component
all component internal variables existentially eliminated
all terminal factor supports subset of frozen bridge
full 2048-assignment independent semantic verification MATCH with FP=0 and FN=0
promotion_rule: An exposed W05 exact factorized match authorizes only post-discovery controls on previously exposed R19 OPEN worlds. A new byte-freeze and fresh unseen holdout are required before any new generalization claim.
claim_ceiling: R23 can show exact component-factorization behavior on one exposed world only. It does not establish bounded treewidth, polynomial decomposition size, arbitrary-CNF totality, SAT-in-P, P=NP, or P!=NP.
